track: BANKING_ASR (IndicVoices Digital Payment Commands; project annotations pending)

dataset.citation: Javed et al., IndicVoices: Towards building an Inclusive Multilingual Speech Dataset for Indian Languages, Findings of ACL 2024 (arXiv:2403.01926)

source_subset.match: exact equality on the IndicVoices task_name column

split_rationale.why_train: The valid split has too few Digital Payment Commands speakers once the Phase 3.2B-8 quality rules and the general-set speaker exclusion are applied (Kannada 6 DPC speakers -> 5 eligible -> 0 not in the general set; Hindi 26 -> 24 -> 18). The train split at the same revision is the only in-dataset source large enough for 100 speakers per language.

known_limitations: Train-split clips: ASR models trained on IndicVoices train (for example AI4Bharat IndicVoices-trained models) may have seen these exact recordings. Check each candidate model's training data before comparing it with Whisper-small on this set.
IndicVoices train and valid are not speaker-disjoint. Only the speakers in the frozen general manifest are excluded here, as specified; other valid-split speakers may appear.
Every Digital Payment Commands row is scenario 'Read' (prompted read speech), not spontaneous speech.
References write numbers as words, so amounts and identifiers in reference_transcript are word sequences, not digit strings.

selection_rules.exclude_speakers: every speaker_id in indicvoices_general_manifest.json, both languages
selection_rules.procedure: rows sorted by (source_file, row_in_file); quality rules applied; general-set speakers removed; eligible speakers sorted then shuffled with the seeded RNG; each speaker's rows shuffled with the same RNG in that order; the first row of each of the first 100 speakers is selected; output ordered by (source_file, row_in_file)

reference_conventions: reference_transcript is the IndicVoices 'normalized' field; 200/200 selected rows have normalized identical to text.
0/200 selected references contain an ASCII digit.
0/200 selected references contain a Latin letter.
verbatim_transcript is kept for audit only; score against reference_transcript.
row_identity: source_file + row_in_file at the pinned revision; audio_name_in_parquet and samples must both match when audio is extracted, or the row is rejected.

fetch.method: HfFileSystem range reads at the pinned revision: task_name for every train shard, then metadata/transcript columns for row groups containing Digital Payment Commands rows. audio_filepath.bytes never requested.
fetch.snapshot: not stored; re-run `fetch` and compare each language's snapshot_dpc_rows_sha256 before re-running `select`

project_annotations.status: pending; every value is null until annotated
